title: The Door
_about: Episode 2. Grub kidnaps the village chicken and hides behind his 'unbreakable' door. Reginald bounces off it, Bumblewick's fireball backfires, Mark reads the sign: PULL.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Quest two! Grub kidnapped the village chicken!

lines.speaker: grub
lines.text: Hehehe! This door is unbreakable! You'll never get in here!

lines.speaker: reginald
lines.text: Unbreakable? Stand aside! No door can stop Sir Reginald!

lines.speaker: bumblewick
lines.text: Hmm... allow me... a fireball spell!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Quest two complete... nobody reads the signs.
